name: The Cosmic Orchestra
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Live On The Porch (Smithtown) - show calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The band's site has no social links. A Linktree (linktr.ee/TheCosmicOrchestra) reportedly lists a Facebook page, but Linktree is blocked by robots.txt, so Facebook was not verified or recorded. Spotify artist ID comes from their track 'Evil' (with Eugene Ruffolo). This is a seated concert act (soulful reworked covers), not a dance band. No logo on the site. Skipped album-cover art and a backstage selfie.
description: Collective of New York and Long Island studio musicians and singer-songwriters (including producer Ben Wisch and singers Eugene Ruffolo and Jon Preddice) who play their own soulful, reworked arrangements of well-known songs, mostly in concert settings.
